messages:
Sam: Kicking off NorthBridge POC thread. Security team sent SAML + SCIM + RBAC checklist. Need concrete answers for: SCIM delta window, SCIM rate limits, SAML attribute mapping, role provisioning, domain ownership proof, and Hosted vs Dedicated identity differences. Also need POC pricing ballpark. @Priyanka @Elaine can you jump in?

Priyanka: SCIM defaults: delta_window=900s (15m). For Dedicated we can drop to 300s (5m) if they need near-realtime. Default rate limit = 300 req/min/tenant; for the POC we can bump to 600 req/min. Recommend using batching for initial bulk imports.

Priyanka: sample config: `scim.delta_window_seconds=900; scim.rate_limit_per_min=300; scim.batch_enabled=true`

Elaine: RBAC mapping: we support roles from SAML assertion attribute `roles` and group->role mapping from SCIM groups. We require an explicit mapping table; we do not auto-ish elevate anyone. Delegated admin is opt-in and has additional audit logs. Example: `ProdAdmin -> platform_admin`, `ReadOnly -> viewer`.

Jordan: Hosted vs Dedicated: both support SAML/OIDC + SCIM. Dedicated adds private KMS, VPC egress controls, and customizable rate limits. Fallback auth (magic link email) is available for Hosted as an opt-in; Dedicated allows it but depends on customer's networking policy.

Ida: Domain ownership: we support DNS TXT verification and signed SAML metadata verification. Which does NorthBridge prefer?

Sam: They said DNS TXT verification for now. Also security asked: what happens if IdP is down  can users still login? Need explicit statement for questionnaire.

Elaine: Short answer: fallback via email magic link is supported when enabled and logged. For Dedicated, it depends on network policies and whether customer allows outbound email flow. We'll document it in the questionnaire.

Jordan: Pricing note for Sales: Hosted POC generally on usage + free credits for short trials. Dedicated needs a monthly commit; size based on sustained QPS. Sam, please share expected user counts and group counts so infra can size the Dedicated quote and SCIM limits.

Sam: POC numbers: ~18k total users, ~3k daily delta ops, initial group import ~120 groups. I'll add a sheet.

ops-bot: Staging tenant deploy scheduled 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z for POC.

Priyanka: For this POC we'll set `rate_limit_per_min=600` and enable SCIM batch endpoint. Test PATCH example for our QA: `PATCH /scim/v2/Users` with body `[ { "op": "replace", "path": "emails[0].value", "value": "user@example.com" } ]`.

Sam: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
